hooks.statusMessage: 版本号 +1，重建 IPK，上传 Release...
hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, re, os, subprocess

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')

if not re.search(r'git\\s+commit\\b', cmd):
    sys.exit(0)

repo = '/Users/lxf/Code/OpenWrt_RDP_Auth'
ver_path = os.path.join(repo, 'VERSION')

with open(ver_path) as f:
    ver = f.read().strip()

major, minor, patch = ver.split('.')
new_ver = f'{major}.{minor}.{int(patch)+1}'

with open(ver_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_ver + '\\n')

subprocess.run(['python3', 'build.sh'], cwd=repo, check=True)

ipk = os.path.join(repo, f'rdp-controller_{new_ver}_all.ipk')
tag = f'v{new_ver}'

subprocess.run(['git', 'tag', '-f', tag], cwd=repo, check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'push', 'origin', tag, '--force'], cwd=repo, check=True)

try:
    subprocess.run(['gh', 'release', 'create', tag, '--title', tag, '--notes', f'Release {tag}'], cwd=repo)
except:
    pass

subprocess.run(['gh', 'release', 'upload', tag, ipk, '--clobber'], cwd=repo, check=True)

print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': f'\u2705 {new_ver} \u5df2\u6784\u5efa\u5e76\u4e0a\u4f20\u81f3 GitHub Release {tag}'}))
"
